bic_trace_step.reason: The function `rxgk_verify_response()` contains the vulnerable logic on lines 981-983. It reads the untrusted `token_len` from the packet header and performs `xdr_round_up(token_len)` before validating it against `len`. If `token_len` is a large value close to `UINT_MAX`, `xdr_round_up(token_len)` can overflow and wrap around to a small value, bypassing the bounds check `if (xdr_round_up(token_len) + sizeof(__be32) > len)`. This allows subsequent operations like `rxgk_extract_token()` to be called with an out-of-bounds `token_len` value.
